title: Learning Which Evidence-Seeking Decisions Matter: Calibrated Counterfactual Replay for Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.05263v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language agents answer questions by searching, reading, and checking claims. A reward on the final answer says little about which of those decisions earned it, since an agent can reach the right string after redundant searches or with half the evidence missing. We treat the question as an experiment. At a saved decision point, PCCC-RL, for prefix-conditioned counterfactual credit, restores the tool state, runs the action the agent chose alongside a feasible alternative, and lets the same frozen policy finish both branches. The difference in final score then samples what the decision was worth. translated_title: 学习哪些证据寻求决策才是重要的：面向语言智能体的校准反事实重放方法
translated_abstract: 语言智能体通过搜索、阅读和核查声明来回答问题。仅凭最终答案的奖励很难说明是哪些决策为其赢得了正确结果，因为智能体可能在冗余搜索之后、或在缺少一半证据的情况下依然得到正确的答案字符串。我们将这个问题视为一个实验。在保存的决策点上，PCCC-RL（前缀条件反事实信用分配方法）会恢复工具状态，同时运行智能体所选择的动作和一个可行的替代动作，并让同一个冻结策略完成这两个分支。最终得分的差异便抽样出该决策的真实价值。由于重放所有内容代价过高，该方法预先预测每个动作的信用值，随机抽取一个子集进行验证，并利用记录的选择概率来纠正预测误差，将预算花费在进一步的检查仍能改变训练信号的地方。替代动作仅从前缀中抽取，这保持了……
tldr: 提出了PCCC-RL方法，通过前缀条件下的反事实重放、预先信用预测与基于选择概率的校准纠正机制，精准识别语言智能体中哪些证据寻求决策真正决定了最终答案的质量，从而解决稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题。
en_tdlr: PCCC-RL introduces calibrated counterfactual replay that predicts each action's credit upfront, verifies a random subset, and corrects predictions using recorded selection probabilities, enabling language agents to learn which evidence-seeking decisions actually matter for the final answer.
